## Story

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

A pod sits on a stem. It is a dry pod. The sun is hot. Pop!

</div>

## Think About It

1. What splits the pod? (The hot sun.)
2. What lifts the seeds? (The wind.)
3. Why was the last spot a fit spot? (It had sun and mud.)
4. What pops up from the seed? (A stem — a plant!)
